description: The Science Data Bank release covers a landslide inventory and susceptibility assessment for Gilgit-Baltistan in northern Pakistan, along the China–Pakistan Economic Corridor. The producer team combines historical records, field surveys and time-series ground-deformation evidence, checked against high-resolution imagery, to span 1970–2024. It also publishes geomorphological slope units, 11 conditioning factors and CatBoost-based susceptibility results. The named page is public under CC BY 4.0. Route planners or infrastructure modellers could overlay the inventory and susceptibility outputs with roads, bridges or other assets to test landslide exposure and alternative alignments. The susceptibility map is model-derived, not a measured future failure probability. The repository explicitly notes that remote mountain access creates spatial sampling bias, which the multi-source design reduces but cannot prove absent. Exact file encoding, event completeness and predictive skill at an individual slope were not checked by download. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
name: A Multi-source Fusion Landslide Inventory and Susceptibility Assessment Dataset for Gilgit-Baltistan, Pakistan
